notes.title: The 'Look better' update!
notes.notes:
Surprise update! While I wasn't planning on releasing any further updates until the big Yokai Hunter boss fight reveal, but I wanted to share some more improvements with you all.

Here is a quick list of the changes:
[list]
[*] Updated music for the Yokai Forest and Yokai VIllage!
[*] Updated graphics for the backgrounds
[*] Fixed and added graphics to many of the enemies
[*] Added additional cutscenes
[/list]

Until February,

Bye!

notes.title: November Patch and Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New update for Mizuki and the Crimson Moon! New mechanics and plenty of bug fixes. Even if you've played it before, you going to want to check this out![/h2]

Some of the big changes include:
[list]
[*] The ability to BREAK enemies. Attack most enemies just right to stun them for a couple seconds.
[*] A healing ability for Mizuki! Spend all of your remaining wisps to recover some health. Just don't get hit!
[*] Directional attacking, even in the air!
[*] Many small gameplay balances
[*] Lot of bug fixes
[/list]
If you enjoy it, please leave a review and tell me your thoughts! Stuff like that goes a long way in helping a small indie developer like me. Feel free to reach out via email, discord, or social media!

Until next time!

notes.title: October Update and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

This October welcomes several changes to the Mizuki and the Crimson Moon demo! For anyone who reads this, thank you for your interest in my small demo. I am now working on the final update to the demo, and it's going to be a large one. If you have any feedback or suggestions at all, please email me, contact me on social media, or message me on the Mizuki and the Crimson Moon discord channel! You can also leave a review for the game on its demo page.
[url=https://discord.gg/GEAZAQj6TC]Official Mizuki and the Crimson Moon Discord[/url]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/critsonastick.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url]
[url=https://x.com/rickard256]Twitter / X[/url]
Business Email: mizukiandthecrimsonmoon@gmail.com

The main changes revolve around bug fixes, enemy AI adjustments, and a few gameplay improvements. Here are some of the changes you might notice:
[list]
[*] The Human Guard enemy no longer counter-attacks after being attacked, but no longer takes knockback from attacks
[*] Adjusted the health of the Human Scout from 6 to 4
[*] Added a ranged attack to the Yurei
[*] Adjusted the rage-AI of the Yurei to respond better to the player
[*] Adjusted the range of the Yurei melee swipes
[*] Rebalanced stage difficulty
[*] Adjusted Kappa's dialog for unlocking a health upgrade
[*] Several minor bug fixes and sprite alterations
[/list]

Thank you for playing Mizuki and the Crimson Moon! See you next month!

notes.title: October Update and Bug Fix Delayed
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today I was planning to release an update to Mizuki and the Crimson Moon which would contain bug fixes, polish, and some enemy AI changes. Unfortunately, this update will be delayed a few days because of some issues that I am having with uploading the update to Steam. Please stay tuned, as the update will be made as soon as possible!

notes.title: Demo Version 2 is Out!
notes.notes:
​It has been a busy week, but a new demo version has been [b]released[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002704/13214ae111dc29cf81ffd7c8386c992e66287bd7.png[/img]
This version of the demo comes with many bug fixes, polished gameplay mechanics, and a few new features. I hope you'll take the time to explore the new demo, even if you have already played before!

Here are a couple of the big changes you'll notice:
[list]
[*] Revamped settings with a couple new options.
[*] Stages balanced with fairer enemy placements.
[*] A purchasable upgrade for teleporting.
[*] An extended stage 5.
[*] And more :)
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy this version of the demo! Don't forget to leave a review and send me your thoughts on the game! It is always greatly appreciated!

notes.title: September Updates and Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello!
I have been hard at work getting an update ready for September which you can expect to release on September 17th, just in time for Tsukimi! Tsukimi is the annual celebration of the moon in Japan. Since Mizuki and the Crimson Moon takes place during Tsukimi, I thought it was appropriate to plan the next big demo update for this event.

First of all, thank you so much for playing the demo! I really appreciate all of the comments and feedback left on the demo so far, and you can be sure that I am doing what I can to address as many of them as I can for the next update! Here is a list of changes that you can expect when the update launches:
[list]
[*] More fluid and responsive teleporting
[*] Faster attacking, which should lead to smoother combat
[*] Enemies will have a delay before reacting to a teleport
[*] Better enemy balance throughout each stage
[*] A teleport range indicator
[*] The option to attack in the direction of the cursor (toggle in settings)
[*] Expanded enemy AI
[*] An expanded stage 5
[*] Special unlockables for collecting the feathers in each stage
[*] As many updated graphics as I can manage
[*] Tons and tons of bug fixes
[*] Hopefully more bonus features and such...
[/list]
There may be more that is changed or updated before the release, but this list is a start of what you can expect.

If you want to give me more feedback on the demo, please leave a review on the demo page or join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/GEAZAQj6TC]Official Mizuki and the Crimson Moon Discord[/url] to reach out to me!

That is all I have for now.
Thank you so much for playing Mizuki and the Crimson Moon!

notes.title: Mizuki and the Crimson Moon Demo Released
notes.notes:
[u][b][h1]Come check out the demo of Mizuki and the Crimson Moon![/h1][/b][/u]
This is an early build of the game, showcasing the first area, the Yokai Forest! In this demo you can play though the first five stages and explore Yokai Village. Players can get a good handle on the controls with these first stages and see what the game will have to offer. Note that this version of the game [b]IS NOT[/b] final and many things are subject to change between now and the release of the game. There will be quite a few features that will be added over time, and the demo will be updated when possible to fix any bugs of issues that are discovered.
If you find a bug or want to give feedback, please email me at mizukiandthecrimsonmoon@gmail.com

[previewyoutube=dPP0A3Tal9g;full][/previewyoutube]

All feedback is welcome!

[h2]I hope you all enjoy the demo![/h2]
